originals.why: In this question, o gwbl means 'any/at all', with no negative. The course teaches o gwbl as 전혀, and 전혀 only works with a negative, so the Korean can't be both natural and faithful. 'dach chi' with no 'esgusodwch fi' also leaves it unclear whether the addressee is plural or formal.

originals.ko: 그는 전혀 도움을 요청하고 싶어하지 않았어
originals.why: 'gofyn am help' means 'ask for help'. The glosses 묻다 and ~에 대해 would give '도움에 대해 묻다' (ask about help), which is the wrong meaning, so the Korean uses 요청하다. The Welsh is natural and uses o gwbl in the negative sense this course teaches.
